Art-directed case study / Information design

A compact publication with a clear message

Project intention

Two sides of a compact folded information piece. Its success depends on communicating the essential sequence without making either side feel crowded.

Design decisions

The physical constraint is the design brief: a short information route, two carefully organised sides, and enough contrast to identify the next step.
